text.p: Sunrise Resources Inc said on Tuesday that it entered into a $20 million securitization vendor program financing agreement with Dougherty Dawkins Inc.
At the closing on November 8, an initial advance of $13 million was made to finance certain equipment leases associated with the company's vendor lease programs with Sun Microsystems Inc.
The remaining $7 million of the facility will be used to finance additional Sun Microsystems equipment lease transactions over the next several months.
In addition, Sunrise said it entered into a vendor lease program agreement with Auspex Systems Inc on November 8. Auspex develops software products.

Sunrise further said two loan defaults earlier reported with King Management Co and Daiwa Bank were resolved. All loans for King Management have been repaid and the company now is in compliance and in good standing with Daiwa Bank.
Sunrise offers third-party leasing and vendor leasing programs.
